options.text: the emitter has higher degree of doping compared to that of the collector
the collector has higher degree of doping compared to that of the emitter
both the emitter and collector have same degree of doping
the base region is most heavily doped

solution.text: In an $n-p-n$ or $p-n-p$ transistor, the left hand side thick layer of the transistor is heavily doped known as emitter and right hand side thick layer of the transistor is moderately doped known as collector.
